1 台伺服器
一台伺服器，流量節節上升

segments.en: Each request is a fan loading a page, and fans arrive in bursts, like real traffic. The server works on 2 requests at a time, and each needs about 20 ms of work. That comes out to roughly 100 requests per second (simulated numbers, not a benchmark). Every response also spends 40 ms on the network. Requests that arrive while both workers are busy wait in line.
segments.zh: 每個請求代表一位歌迷在載入頁面，而且歌迷會一波一波湧進來，就像真實的流量。這台伺服器一次能處理 2 個請求，每個請求大約需要 20 毫秒的運算，換算起來大約是每秒 100 個請求（模擬數字，不是效能基準）。每個回應還要花 40 毫秒在網路上。兩個工作者都在忙的時候進來的請求，只能排隊等。

segments.en: Latency vs throughput in one line
segments.zh: 一句話說清楚延遲與吞吐量

segments.en: Latency is how long one request takes. Throughput is how many requests finish per second. Near a server's limit, throughput stops rising and latency shoots up.
segments.zh: 延遲（latency）是一個請求花多久。吞吐量（throughput）是每秒完成多少個請求。接近伺服器的極限時，吞吐量停止成長，延遲則會暴衝。
第 2 幕 · 為什麼平均值會騙人

segments.en: 100 real requests, sorted from fastest to slowest
segments.zh: 100 個真實請求，從快排到慢

segments.en: These are the last 100 requests your simulated server finished. (If you haven't run the lab yet, this is a sample at 100 requests/second.) Switch between the two lines.
segments.zh: 這是你的模擬伺服器最近完成的 100 個請求。（如果你還沒跑過實驗室，這裡顯示的是每秒 100 個請求的樣本。）切換看看兩條線。
↻ 抓最新的 100 個
關鍵差別

segments.en: The average blends everyone into one number that describes nobody. P99 is the time the slowest 1% of users waited. Those are the fans writing to support.
segments.zh: 平均值把所有人混成一個數字，結果誰也描述不了。P99 是最慢那 1% 使用者等待的時間，也就是寫信給客服的那些歌迷。
第 3 幕 · 尾端延遲會被放大
扇出
一個頁面，很多次呼叫

segments.en: Encore's concert page doesn't make one request. It calls the seat map, prices, recommendations, reviews… Each call is slow only 1% of the time. But the page is slow if any of its calls is slow.
segments.zh: Encore 的演唱會頁面不只發出一個請求。它會呼叫座位圖、票價、推薦、評論……每次呼叫只有 1% 的機率很慢。但只要任何一個呼叫慢了，整個頁面就慢了。

segments.en: Backend calls per page load: 10
segments.zh: 每次載入頁面的後端呼叫數：10
尾端延遲

segments.en: The rare slow requests at the end of the distribution are the tail. With fan-out, rare per call becomes common per page, so big systems watch P99 and even P99.9.
segments.zh: 分布最末端那些罕見的慢請求，就是尾端（tail）。有了扇出（fan-out），每次呼叫的「罕見」會變成每個頁面的「常見」，所以大型系統會盯著 P99，甚至 P99.9。

倒楣的人有多慘
P99 / 尾端

segments.en: 99% of requests were faster than this. The tail grows first when a server gets busy, and fan-out makes it everyone's problem.
segments.zh: 99% 的請求都比這個快。伺服器一忙，尾端最先變長；而扇出會讓它變成每個人的問題。
取捨

segments.en: Running a server closer to 100% busy gets more throughput per dollar, but latency explodes near the limit. Leave headroom, and judge speed by P99, not the average.
segments.zh: 讓伺服器跑在接近 100% 忙碌，每一塊錢能換到更多吞吐量，但接近極限時延遲會爆炸。保留餘裕，並且用 P99 而不是平均值來評斷速度。
考考自己
'在正常流量（每秒 40 個請求）下按播放。'

segments.en: 'Average and P99 sit close together. Nobody waits.'
segments.zh: '平均和 P99 很接近，沒有人在等。'

segments.en: 'Slide traffic up to 100 requests/second and keep it there for a few seconds.'
segments.zh: '把流量拉到每秒 100 個請求，維持幾秒鐘。'

segments.en: 'The server is about 95% busy, so short lines form at random. Watch P99 pull away from the average.'
segments.zh: '伺服器大約 95% 忙碌，所以會隨機出現短暫的排隊。看 P99 怎麼跟平均值拉開距離。'
'按下開賣尖峰（每秒 130 個）。'

segments.en: 'Throughput gets stuck near 100/s. The line grows every second, so every request waits longer.'
segments.zh: '吞吐量卡在每秒 100 左右。隊伍每秒都在變長，所以每個請求都等得更久。'

segments.en: 'Add a second server while the spike is still running.'
segments.zh: '尖峰還在進行時，加開第二台伺服器。'

segments.en: 'Double the capacity, and the line drains. This is horizontal scaling (page 6).'
segments.zh: '容量加倍，隊伍就會消化掉。這就是水平擴展（第 6 頁）。'
' 毫秒'
'按「播放」開始送出流量。'

segments.en: `✕ Saturated: ${S.rate} requests/s arrive but the ${S.servers === 1 ? 'server' : 'servers'} can only finish about ${cap}/s. The line grows every second, so latency keeps climbing.`
segments.zh: `✕ 飽和：每秒進來 ${S.rate} 個請求，但${S.servers === 1 ? '伺服器' : '伺服器們'}每秒只能完成大約 ${cap} 個。隊伍每秒都在變長，所以延遲持續攀升。`

segments.en: `⚠ Busy: requests are starting to queue. The slowest ones (P99 ${X.fmt(m.p99)} ms) feel it long before the average (${X.fmt(m.avg)} ms) does.`
segments.zh: `⚠ 忙碌：請求開始排隊了。最慢的那些（P99 ${X.fmt(m.p99)} 毫秒）會比平均值（${X.fmt(m.avg)} 毫秒）早很多感受到。`

segments.en: `✓ Healthy: requests start almost as soon as they arrive. P99 ${X.fmt(m.p99)} ms.`
segments.zh: `✓ 健康：請求幾乎一到就開始處理。P99 ${X.fmt(m.p99)} 毫秒。`
'平均'
'兩者'
`${label} ${X.fmt(v)} 毫秒`

segments.en: `Average: ${X.fmt(avg)} ms. Half of these requests finished under ${X.fmt(p50)} ms, and the slowest took ${X.fmt(sample[99])} ms. The average hides that.`
segments.zh: `平均：${X.fmt(avg)} 毫秒。一半的請求在 ${X.fmt(p50)} 毫秒內完成，最慢的花了 ${X.fmt(sample[99])} 毫秒。平均值把這件事藏起來了。`

segments.en: `P99: ${X.fmt(p99)} ms. 99 of 100 requests were faster than this. The red bar${slow > 1 ? 's are' : ' is'} the fan${slow > 1 ? 's' : ''} who emailed support. The average (${X.fmt(avg)} ms) is ${(p99 / Math.max(avg, 1)).toFixed(1)}× smaller.`
segments.zh: `P99：${X.fmt(p99)} 毫秒。100 個請求中有 99 個比這個快。紅色長條就是寫信給客服的歌迷。平均值（${X.fmt(avg)} 毫秒）小了 ${(p99 / Math.max(avg, 1)).toFixed(1)} 倍。`

segments.en: `Each square is one page load. ${slow} of these 100 hit at least one slow call (red). On average, ${exp.toFixed(1)}% of page loads would. With 1 call it's 1%.`
segments.zh: `每個方塊代表一次頁面載入。這 100 次中有 ${slow} 次碰到至少一個慢呼叫（紅色）。平均而言，${exp.toFixed(1)}% 的頁面載入會這樣。只有 1 次呼叫時是 1%。`

segments.en: '# Throughput: requests finished per second'
segments.zh: '# 吞吐量：每秒完成的請求數'

segments.en: '# Average latency: total time ÷ number of requests'
segments.zh: '# 平均延遲：總時間 ÷ 請求數'

segments.en: '# P99: 99% of requests were faster than this'
segments.zh: '# P99：99% 的請求都比這個快'
'吞吐量'

segments.en: 'Counts finished requests and turns the count into “per second”, averaged over the last minute. This is the Throughput meter.'
segments.zh: '計算已完成的請求數，並換算成「每秒」，取最近一分鐘的平均。這就是吞吐量儀表。'
'平均延遲'

segments.en: 'Total seconds spent on requests ÷ number of requests. Simple, and the reason dashboards can look calm while fans suffer.'
segments.zh: '花在請求上的總秒數 ÷ 請求數。很簡單，也正是儀表板看起來風平浪靜、歌迷卻在受苦的原因。'

segments.en: 'Asks for the 99th percentile. Change 0.99 to 0.5 and you get the median, or to 0.999 for the deeper tail.'
segments.zh: '要求第 99 百分位數。把 0.99 改成 0.5 就是中位數，改成 0.999 就能看更深的尾端。'
'分桶與時間窗'

segments.en: 'Servers count requests into time buckets (under 50 ms, under 100 ms, …). The quantile is estimated from those buckets over the last 5 minutes. Short windows react faster, long ones are smoother.'
segments.zh: '伺服器會把請求依時間分進不同的桶（50 毫秒以內、100 毫秒以內……）。百分位數是根據最近 5 分鐘的分桶估算出來的。時間窗短反應快，時間窗長比較平滑。'

segments.en: 'The dashboard shows an average latency of 90 ms, but fans say checkout “hangs”. What do you check first?'
segments.zh: '儀表板顯示平均延遲 90 毫秒，但歌迷說結帳「卡住」。你第一個該看什麼？'
'結帳的 P99 延遲'

segments.en: 'The average blends a few very slow requests in with many fast ones. P99 shows what the unlucky fans are actually waiting.'
segments.zh: '平均值把少數很慢的請求和大量快速的請求混在一起。P99 才會顯示倒楣的歌迷實際等了多久。'

segments.en: 'The average over a longer time window'
segments.zh: '拉長時間窗的平均值'

segments.en: 'A longer window smooths things even more. It hides the slow requests instead of revealing them.'
segments.zh: '更長的時間窗會讓數字更平滑，反而把慢請求藏起來，而不是揭露它們。'
'伺服器 CPU 是不是到 100%'

segments.en: 'Useful later, but it doesn\'t tell you what users feel. Latency percentiles do.'
segments.zh: '之後有用，但它無法告訴你使用者的感受。延遲百分位數才能。'

segments.en: 'Traffic grows from 50 to 120 requests/second on a server that tops out around 100/s. What happens?'
segments.zh: '一台上限大約每秒 100 個請求的伺服器，流量從每秒 50 成長到 120。會發生什麼事？'

segments.en: 'Latency roughly doubles and then stays steady'
segments.zh: '延遲大約翻倍，然後維持穩定'

segments.en: 'Past the limit it doesn\'t settle. Requests pile up faster than they finish, so the wait keeps growing every second.'
segments.zh: '超過極限後不會穩定下來。請求堆積的速度比完成的速度快，所以等待時間每秒都在增加。'

segments.en: 'Throughput gets stuck near 100/s and latency keeps climbing as the line grows'
segments.zh: '吞吐量卡在每秒 100 左右，而且隊伍越來越長、延遲持續攀升'

segments.en: 'Throughput has a ceiling. Everything above it waits in line, and the line grows until requests time out.'
segments.zh: '吞吐量有天花板。超出的部分全都在排隊，隊伍會一直變長，直到請求逾時。'
'CPU 到 100% 之前什麼都不會變'

segments.en: 'Queuing starts well before 100%. You saw P99 rise at around 90% busy.'
segments.zh: '排隊在 100% 之前很久就開始了。你已經看到 P99 在大約 90% 忙碌時上升。'

segments.en: 'Encore\'s concert page calls 20 backend services. Each one is slow 1% of the time. Roughly how often is the page slow?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 的演唱會頁面會呼叫 20 個後端服務，每個都有 1% 的機率很慢。頁面大約多常會變慢？'
'大約 1%，跟每次呼叫一樣'

segments.en: 'The page waits for all 20. Any one of them being slow makes the page slow.'
segments.zh: '頁面要等全部 20 個都回來。只要其中一個慢，頁面就慢。'

segments.en: '1 − 0.99²⁰ ≈ 0.18. That\'s why big systems care so much about the tail.'
segments.zh: '1 − 0.99²⁰ ≈ 0.18。這就是大型系統這麼在意尾端的原因。'

segments.en: 'Close, but the chances overlap (sometimes two calls are slow at once). The exact answer is 1 − 0.99²⁰ ≈ 18%.'
segments.zh: '很接近，但機率會重疊（有時候兩個呼叫同時很慢）。正確答案是 1 − 0.99²⁰ ≈ 18%。'
